SELECT icam10_fee_id AS fee_id, icam10_std_date AS std_date, icam10_icam_company_cd AS icam_company_code, icam10_icam_company_nm AS icam_company_name, icam10_fund_cd AS fund_code, icam10_fund_nm AS fund_name, icam10_rmk_nm AS rmk_name, icam10_cur_cd AS cur_code, icam10_fee AS fee, icam10_fx_rate AS fx_rate, icam10_af_pay_date AS af_pay_date, icam10_bf_pay_date AS bf_pay_date, to_char(icam10_work_date,'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI:SS') AS work_date_string, icam10_worker AS worker FROM icam10_fee WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY icam10_std_date, icam10_icam_company_cd, icam10_rmk_cd, icam10_fund_cd LIMIT #{p.limit} OFFSET #{p.offset}

SELECT row_number() OVER(ORDER BY icam10_fund_cd) AS fee_id , icam10_fund_cd AS fund_code , COALESCE(fnd02_fund_nm, icam10_fund_nm) AS fund_name FROM icam10_fee LEFT JOIN ( SELECT fnd01_fund_cd, fnd02_fund_nm FROM fnd01_fund_code INNER JOIN fnd02_fund_info ON ( fnd02_fund_code_id = fnd01_fund_code_id AND fnd02_work_date = ( SELECT MAX(fnd02_work_date) FROM fnd02_fund_info WHERE fnd02_fund_code_id = fnd01_fund_code_id AND fnd02_work_date <= #{stdDate} ) ) WHERE fnd01_company_id = #{companyId} ) fnd ON fnd01_fund_cd = icam10_fund_cd WHERE icam10_company_id = #{companyId} AND icam10_std_date >= #{stdDate} AND UPPER(CONCAT(icam10_fund_cd, icam10_fund_nm)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) GROUP BY icam10_fund_cd, COALESCE(fnd02_fund_nm, icam10_fund_nm) ORDER BY icam10_fund_cd
